bestiary_select_species: player selected {event_data[species_id]} in the species tab
bestiary_select_environment: player selected {event_data[environment_id]} in the environment tab
bestiary_select_model: player selected '{event_data[model_id]}' in the model tab
model_phase_changed: switched to the '{event_data[phase]}' phase of modeling
model_concept_started: started a 'concept' model in the '{event_data[ecosystem]}' ecosystem
begin_simulation: started a 'simulation' model in the '{event_data[ecosystem]}' ecosystem
model_sync_error: simulation model's synchronization failed, with '{event_data[sync]}'% synchronization
model_predict_completed: finished building prediction model for '{event_data[ecosystem]}' ecosystem
model_intervene_update: intervention model for '{event_data[ecosystem]}' ecosystem updated to change {event_data[organism]} population by {event_data[difference_value]}
model_intervene_completed: finished building intervention model for '{event_data[ecosystem]}' ecosystem
insufficient_funds: player could not afford {event_data[item_name]} at price of ${event_data[cost]}
talk_to_shopkeep: player started speaking to the shopkeeper
begin_experiment: started an experiment on {event_data[critters]} in the {event_data[tank_type]} tank, with the {event_data[environment]} environment
end_experiment: ended the experiment in the {event_data[tank_type]} tank
fact_rejected: the '{event_data[fact_id]}' fact was rejected as an argument
survey_submitted: player submitted the '{event_data[display_event_id]}' part of the '{event_data[package_config_id]}' survey
